narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional teaser for an upcoming '欸Night' fan meetup, using the milestone of the channel's 7-year anniversary to build excitement. It employs a comedic structure by contrasting the main creators' lively discussion with a friend's apparent boredom, followed by an aggressive, humorous endorsement from an older fan to create a memorable call to action.
